name_note: GTDB calls this species Oliverpabstia tarda, while the genomes it holds carry the NCBI names Oliverpabstia intestinalis and Blautia tarda; the cited papers name the genus Oliverpabstia or the species Oliverpabstia intestinalis.

sentences.text: A multicentre study of Parkinson disease that linked caffeine metabolites to gut microbiome alterations by shotgun metagenomic sequencing named Oliverpabstia intestinalis among the species examined.
A three-month lifestyle intervention in individuals with metabolic syndrome was reported to increase butyrate-producing and anti-inflammatory genera including Oliverpabstia.
In a study where sows received antibiotics or saline during gestation, Oliverpabstia in piglet faeces was positively associated with growth.
